title: Compliance Holdback on Northloop Payments On-Demand Payouts
content:
Active policy violation points on a seller's Seller Performance Standing record lead Northloop to keep back a compliance holdback from the seller's Northloop Payments on-demand payouts.

**Rule.** The compliance holdback is the on-demand payable amount times a compliance holdback share of 0.10 when the seller's standing record carries at least 6 active violation points, 0.05 when it carries 1 to 5, and 0 when it carries none, rounded to the cent.

It is deducted from the on-demand payable amount together with any other holdback kept back from the payout; the on-demand payout so obtained is never below zero, is capped at the plan's maximum per payout and is rounded to the cent. What is kept back stays in the balance and is paid with later scheduled payouts.

| Active violation points on the Seller Performance Standing record | Compliance holdback share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.10 |
| 1 to 5 | 0.05 |
| none | 0 |

*Hypothetical worked example.* On an on-demand payable amount of 9500.00 USD, a seller with 6 active violation points has a compliance holdback of 950.00 USD; with 5 points it is 475.00 USD; with none, nothing is kept back on this count.
